question: No one has petitioned for a color we'd like to use in body lotion. Can FDA list it, or exempt it from certification, on its own?
answer: The generated answer could not be validated against the retrieved regulatory evidence, so it is not shown. The retrieved sources were not verified to answer the question as asked, so their text is not quoted as an answer. Sources consulted: 21 CFR 80.35(b), 21 CFR 73.1, 21 CFR 80.35(c), 21 CFR 80.35(a), 21 CFR 73.1001.

sources.heading: Color additive mixtures; certification and exemption from certification.
sources.text: (b) Color additive mixtures exempted from certification. A color additive mixture prepared from a previously certified batch of one or more straight colors, with or without any diluent that has been listed in part 73 of this chapter for use in mixtures, shall be exempt from batch certification if the straight color used has not changed in composition in any manner whatsoever since its certification and if it is simply mixed with the approved diluents for exempt mixtures. The label of such color additive mixtures shall not bear the lot number assigned by the Food and Drug Administration to the certified straight color components, but shall bear the manufacturer's control number through which the history of the straight color can be determined.

sources.heading: Diluents in color additive mixtures for food use exempt from certification.
sources.text: The following substances may be safely used as diluents in color additive mixtures for food use exempt from certification, subject to the condition that each straight color in the mixture has been exempted from certification or, if not so exempted, is from a batch that has previously been certified and has not changed in composition since certification. If a specification for a particular diluent is not set forth in this part 73, the material shall be of a purity consistent with its intended use.

sources.heading: Color additive mixtures; certification and exemption from certification.
sources.text: (c) Additions to the list of diluents. A person requesting additions to the list of diluents authorized for the purposes described in paragraphs (a) and (b) of this section shall submit a petition in accordance with the provisions of § 71.1 of this chapter. Each such petition shall be accompanied by the fee prescribed in § 70.19 of this chapter, unless there is an advance deposit to be used for prepayment of such fees.

sources.heading: Color additive mixtures; certification and exemption from certification.
sources.text: (a) Color additive mixtures to be certified. Any color additive mixture that contains one or more straight colors listed in part 74 of this chapter, together with any diluents listed in such subparts for use with such straight colors, shall be certified if intended for use in foods, drugs, or cosmetics, or in coloring the human body, as the case may be, subject to any restriction prescribed in parts 70 and 71 of this chapter.
